title: Discrete differential-geometric Poisson brackets: general theory and explicit constructions
summary: We review the discrete theory of differential-geometric Poisson brackets as introduced by B. A. Dubrovin, and we present a complete proof of their characterisation in the non-degenerate case. We use this characterisation to show several novel examples of such structures, providing a complete classification for non-degenerate four-dimensional differential-geometric Poisson brackets under the additional assumption of the Lie algebra to be of quasi-Frobenius type.
